scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Jharkhand
other_conditions: Applicant must not be receiving pension benefits from any other Central or State Government pension scheme (e.g., Chief Minister State Widow Honor Pension Scheme, Chief Minister State HIV/AIDS Affected Person Sahayataarth Pension Scheme, Swami Vivekanand Disabled Self‑Reliance Promotion Scheme).
Applicant must be suffering from severe or multiple disabilities as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹1000 (₹300 from the Central government and ₹700 from the State government).
